change.title: feat(sidebar): add project grouping and styled folder modal
change.description: ## Summary This PR introduces a robust Project Grouping (folder structure) UI in the sidebar, replacing basic browser native input dialogs (New Group Folder) with a modern custom React modal that aligns with the application's UI design. ### Use Case: Allows developers managing a large number of projects in Termul to group them into folders (e.g., by client, work category, or tech stack). This reduces sidebar clutter, enables collapsible navigation, and makes finding specific project worktrees much faster. ## Related Issue None (Self-contained enhancement for project grouping. Verified that there are no duplicate proposals or issues in the repository.) ## Type of Change - [x] feat: new feature - [ ] fix: bug fix - [ ] docs: documentation only - [ ] style: formatting or non-functional styling changes - [ ] refactor: internal cleanup with no behavior change - [ ] perf: performance improvement - [x] test: adds or updates tests - [ ] build: build or dependency changes - [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow changes - [ ] chore: maintenance or tooling - [ ] revert: reverts a previous change ## What Changed - **New UI Component**: Added `NewGroupModal.tsx` styled to match `NewProjectModal` with smooth scale transitions, backdrop blur, and full keyboard control (Escape/Enter). - **Sidebar Integration**: Integrated folder group views into `ProjectSidebar.tsx` allowing expandable/collapsible folders, project counter badge, and customized context menu options. - **Improved Context Actions**: Replaced the native browser `prompt` dialogs for group creation and project assignment to new groups with the new modal overlay. - **Store & Persistence Update**: Modified `project-store` actions and persistence serializers (`use-projects-persistence.ts`) to track folder grouping state seamlessly. - **Lint Fixes**: Memoized states and resolved ESLint React Hook exhaustive-deps warnings inside the sidebar component to ensure strict pre-commit hooks pass. - **Tests Added**: Added suite of integration tests inside `ProjectSidebar.test.tsx` ensuring group structures load and collapse correctly. ## How It Was Tested - [x] `bun run lint` - [x] `bun run typecheck` - [x] `bun run test` - [x] Manual verification completed - [ ] Not applicable ## Screenshots or Recordings ## Checklist - [x] My PR title follows the conventional commit format used by this repo - [x] I linked the related issue or explained why none exists - [x] I updated docs when needed - [x] I added or updated tests when needed - [x] I verified the change does not introduce unrelated modifications ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Organize active projects into group folders with create/rename/delete, collapse/expand, and reorder. * Move projects between groups or ungroup via project context menu; create-new-group option included. * New modal for creating groups and confirmation dialog for group deletion. * Grouping state is persisted and restored; reordering is disabled while searching. * **Tests** * Added tests covering folder grouping rendering and group removal behavior.

commits.message:
feat(sidebar): add project grouping and styled folder modal

- Implement collapsible project group folders in the project sidebar.
- Create a reusable and styled NewGroupModal component matching the new project modal design.
- Replace browser native prompt dialogs with NewGroupModal for creating and moving groups.
- Update project store actions and persistence layer to support group state serialization.
- Add unit tests for project group interaction in ProjectSidebar.test.tsx.

fix(store): ensure activeProjectId updates when removing group

Recalculates activeProjectId in removeGroup when deleteProjects is enabled.
This prevents the store from keeping a stale reference to a deleted project
if the active project was inside the removed group folder. Also adds unit
tests to verify this behavior.

+describe('ProjectSidebar Folder Grouping', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    // Reset groups in the store before each test
+    useProjectStore.setState({ groups: [] })
+  })
+
+  it('should render active projects grouped under folder section when groups are configured', () => {
+    useProjectStore.setState({
+      groups: [
+        {
+          id: 'group-1',
+          name: 'My Folder',
+          projectIds: ['1'],
+          isCollapsed: false
+        }
+      ]
+    })
+
+    renderWithRouter()
+
+    // Folder header should be visible
+    expect(screen.getByText('My Folder')).toBeInTheDocument()
+    // Project One (id: 1) should be nested inside the folder
+    expect(screen.getByText('Project One')).toBeInTheDocument()
+  })
+
+  it('should hide folder contents when group is collapsed', async () => {
+    useProjectStore.setState({
+      groups: [
+        {
+          id: 'group-1',
+          name: 'My Folder',
+          projectIds: ['1'],
+          isCollapsed: true
+        }
+      ]
+    })
+
+    renderWithRouter()
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('My Folder')).toBeInTheDocument()
+    // Since it is collapsed, Project One should NOT be rendered
+    expect(screen.queryByText('Project One')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
+  })
+})
